stem: Which term is defined as pain perceived in a different location from the site of the painful stimulus, often along a shared nerve pathway?
explanation: Referred pain is pain felt at a site distant from the actual source of noxious stimulation, usually because of shared segmental innervation. This item converts the matching set into a single-best-answer question while preserving the original pain-terminology content.
rationale: The original item was a matching question covering pain terminology. A faithful SBA can ask for one of the terms, such as referred pain, with distractors drawn from the same concept set.

optionExplanations.A: Pain due to a normally non-painful stimulus.
optionExplanations.B: Increased pain response to a normally painful stimulus.
optionExplanations.C: An unpleasant abnormal sensation, spontaneous or evoked.
optionExplanations.D: Pain felt in a different location from the actual source of stimulation.
